import io.xberg.tslp.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {

    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"language\":\"ballerina\"}", ProcessConfig::class.java)
    val result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("public function main() {\n}\n", config)
    println(result)
